comment: With the wizard-only sanity_check option, a debug-mode level teleport to soko1 puts the Sokoban prize (nomerge until picked up) on the floor list, so obj_sanity_check() calls insane_obj_bits() and nomerge_exception() accepts the prize (mkobj.c:3125-3127, 3250-3264, 3279-3283) without a complaint.
